name: Mini Magnetic GPS Tracker with Real-Time Location, Voice & Route Recording
description:
Stay connected and secure with this Mini Magnetic GPS Tracker, designed for kids, elderly, vehicles, and valuables. Compact and discreet, it provides real-time location tracking via Google Maps, along with audio monitoring and recording features. With a strong magnetic mount, it attaches easily to any metal surface, making it a versatile tool for personal and professional use.
Key Features
 Real-time GPS tracking via Google Maps
 Strong magnetic mount for easy placement
 Compact and discreet design for hidden use
 Voice monitoring by dialing SIM directly
 Route recording with up to 16GB TF card (not included)
 Multi-purpose use for people, cars, bikes, or valuables
Ingredients / Materials
High-quality ABS housing, strong neodymium magnet, electronic GPS chipset
How to Use
 Insert a working SIM card into the tracker
 Place the device on a metal surface or carry discreetly
 Track location via SMS or Google Maps link
 Dial the SIM for live audio monitoring
 Insert TF card to record routes if needed
Package Includes
 1 × Mini GPS Tracker Device
 1 × USB Charging Cable
 1 × User Manual
